create.name: Santa Cruz Zen Center / Jorinzan Gyokuon-ji
create.bio:
Santa Cruz Zen Center, whose temple name Jorinzan Gyokuon-ji is rendered as Warm Jewel Temple, is a Soto Zen sangha in the Shunryu Suzuki line, set in a group of houses on Mission Hill a short walk from downtown Santa Cruz, California. It began in 1970, when Kobun Chino Otogawa, then assisting Suzuki at Tassajara, started leading sitting and talks for a local group in a rented church hall. Members later turned a School Street living room into a zendo, incorporated as a nonprofit and held their first seven-day sesshin in 1976. Katherine Thanas was its first abbot; Rev. Patrick Teverbaugh is now practice leader, with Gene Bush and Cathy Toldi as emeritus leaders.

The temple keeps a daily zazen schedule with a dharma talk on Wednesday evenings, a monthly Introduction to Zen class, and retreats of one to seven days, among them the December Rohatsu sesshin. Weekly and monthly groups read Suzuki, Dogen and the Lotus Sutra, several with a Zoom option, and a full-moon ceremony each month renews the bodhisattva precepts. Anyone can ask for a private meeting with a teacher, and recent talks are shared as a podcast.

courses.title: Rohatsu Sesshin
courses.description: Seven days of sitting together to mark the Buddha's awakening, with a daily dharma talk, a work period and formal oryoki meals, closing with an enlightenment ceremony on the last evening. Participants are asked to come for at least two days in a row where they can.
courses.price: Suggested donation $35 daily for Sustaining Members, $40 daily for all others

courses.title: Ongoing Classes and Study Groups
courses.description: Drop-in groups that meet weekly or monthly: a Monday morning dharma study with Rev. Patrick Teverbaugh reading Shunryu Suzuki, a Lotus Sutra reading circle, a group on practising with ageing, and a Zen and art gathering. Several can be joined in the Sangha House or on Zoom.
courses.price: Suggested donation $10 for sustaining members (>$50/mo) and $13 for contributing members and others

courses.title: Practice Discussion (Dokusan)
courses.description: One-to-one meetings with any of the centre's teachers or practice leaders to talk over one's sitting and daily life, arranged by appointment in person, by phone or by video call.

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: Regular monthly, quarterly or yearly giving that sustains the temple. Members can vote for the board, use the library and the sangha support network, and sustaining members pay reduced fees for classes and sesshin.
courses.price: Contributing member: $49 or less monthly; sustaining member: $50 or more monthly

free_resources.title: Santa Cruz Zen Center Dharma Talks Podcast
free_resources.description: Recordings of Wednesday evening and sesshin talks by Patrick Teverbaugh and other teachers and practice leaders, on Dogen, the Heart Sutra, koans, poetry and everyday practice.

free_resources.title: Zazen at Santa Cruz Zen Center
free_resources.description: A short guide to the temple's style of just sitting: posture, breath, hand position and the attitude of shikantaza, with notes on walking meditation, sesshin and the monthly beginners' class.
